> 3 page(s) of developer.paypal.com documentation — Braintree — Docs — Guides under Reports. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Reports

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/reports/overview): Generating reports is a necessary part of running any business. You can pull some of the reporting options available through API.
- [Custom](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/reports/custom/): We believe you should have total control of your data.
- [Webhooks](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/reports/webhooks/): This feature is only available if Braintree manages the funding for your merchant account.
